title: Wage Growth Moving in Tandem with Productivity Gains
what_it_is: Wage Growth Moving in Tandem with Productivity Gains

sections.label: Real wages and productivity growth
sections.summary: From 2001 to 2017 real wages for resident workers grew 1.5% yearly with productivity growth of 2.1%, and from 2011 to 2017 wages rose 1.9% yearly while productivity grew 1.1%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Specifically, from 2001 to 2017, real wages for resident workers grew by 1.5% per annum on the back of productivity growth of 2.1% per annum.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: From 2011 to 2017, real wages for resident workers rose by 1.9% per annum, while productivity grew by only 1.1% per annum over the same period.

sections.label: Capability Development Grant firm outcomes
sections.summary: Firms using the Capability Development Grant between 2005 and 2012 saw a 9.3% average revenue increase, with productivity projects raising revenue 12.4%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, firms that tapped on the Capability Development Grant (CDG) managed by Enterprise Singapore for capability improvement projects between 2005 and 2012 experienced a 9.3% increase in revenue, on average, over time.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Productivity improvement projects had the largest impact, raising firms' revenue by 12.4%, compared to 7.8% for technology innovation projects and an average of 6.7% for the remaining project areas.

sections.label: Grant incentives for easier jobs
sections.summary: The grant provides up to 3,000 incentives to help companies create physically easier, safer and smarter jobs, especially for workers aged above 50.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The grant provides up to 3,000 incentives to help companies create physically easier, safer and smarter jobs, especially for the older workers aged above 50.

sections.label: Progressive Wage Model implementation sectors
sections.summary: The Progressive Wage Model is a productivity-based wage pathway implemented in cleaning, security and landscape, and MOM is ready to support voluntary adoption in other sectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: This model is a productivity-based wage progressive pathway that helps to increase the wages of workers through upgrading skills and improving productivity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So far, this has been implemented in three sectors: the cleaning, security and landscape sectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Minister of State for Manpower Sam Tan mentioned during his COS speech this year that MOM is ready to support tripartite partners to develop and adopt the Progressive Wage Model voluntarily for other sectors.

sections.label: Wholesale trade as attractive sector
sections.summary: Wholesale trade is described as a very good attractive sector that can take in a lot of people with good jobs and good pay.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: One of the sectors that we believe to be a very good attractive sector that can take in a lot of people with good jobs and good pay would be in the area of wholesale trade, which is very diverse.
